Meet your dentist

Dr. Ismail Mohammed

13+ years of experience · Dental Esthetics & Root Canal Treatment

Dr. Ismail believes a trip to the dentist shouldn't be something patients dread. Over more than 13 years of practice, he's built a reputation for calm, careful work and for taking the time to actually explain what's happening in your mouth — not just what needs fixing.
